slides.title: Still asking someone for the [latest logo]?
slides.lede: A DAM earns its place when it cuts the time spent hunting for approved files, recreating existing content and correcting the use of expired photography.

slides.title: Holding files is not the same as [governing them]

cards.label: Cloud storage
cards.text: Basic folders and sharing. Search depends on filenames.

cards.label: DAM
cards.text: Approved versions, owners, rights and where each asset may be used.

items.title: Count the asset types
items.text: Images, video, PDFs, templates, design files.

items.title: Check the file names
items.text: Do they show subject, date or owner?

items.title: Flag restricted assets
items.text: Licences, confidentiality, release forms, expiry dates.

items.title: Map where assets go
items.text: CMS, email, social, print, partner portals.

slides.title: Metadata is a [managed system], not a tagging exercise
slides.text: One person enters 'client event', another 'conference', a third the event name. Search fragments. A controlled vocabulary with named field owners fixes it.

slides.title: The licence is only [part of the cost]
slides.note: The cheapest subscription gets expensive if every channel needs **manual downloading, resizing, renaming and re-uploading**.

slides.quote: There is no universal winner. Start with the workflows that fail today.
slides.text: Canto, Brandfolder, Bynder, Cloudinary, Acquia DAM, Adobe Experience Manager Assets and MediaValet suit different operating models. Test yours in a pilot.
